verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a local API on localhost, bundled with the desktop app and working offline, plus a headless CLI server 'for automation and scripting'. It also publishes a versioned OpenAPI spec and an official MCP server, and agents can programmatically read, search, and modify Objects, which delivers the story's 'local endpoint' route for wiring the app into scripts. missing for 10: evidence of a URI scheme or deep links to open specific notes in the app UI, an explicit create-object endpoint excerpt, independent hands-on corroboration.
